conservative.requirements: INTIMIDATE (STR) Vs. TARGET DISCIPLINE (WP) Target engagement within close range

boon.description: Up to two beastmen within close range may immediately join the engagement as a free manoeuvre

bane.description: An opponent in the targeted engagement may safely leave the engagement as a free manoeuvre. Or an unengaged opponent within close range of the acting beastman may immediately engage the beastman as a free manoeuvre

reckless.requirements: Special: The beastman targets an engagement within close range. The check is opposed by the highest Willpower among enemies in the engagement. Each opponent in the engagement with Discipline trained adds one {Dm} to the dice pool
